game.name: Shift 2 Unleashed (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: Shift 2 Unleashed is a racing simulation game for Xbox 360. The Autolog system is present, allowing you to be connected to other players and see their statistics. Damage management is for both cars and tracks, and you can take the wheel to outwit all the traps you face.
